{{Quote|Yaga Minor is possibly the most heavily defended system in Imperial or New Republic space.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Yaga Minor''' was an industrialized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Yaga Minor primary native [[Species/Legends|species]] were the [[Yaga (species)|Yagai]], insectoids with a hive-caste society and was known throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] for its major [[Starship/Legends|starshipbuilding]] [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|facilities]]. It was famous for where the [[Outbound Flight]] departed towards the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].

==History==
===Inter-Sith Wars Period===
During the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]] was lured to Yaga Minor along with his army. Once lured to the world, Desolous and his army engaged a small number of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Shortly after the start of the conflict, a Jedi flotilla dropped out of hyperspace preventing escape by the Sith and his army. Outnumbered and outmatched by the Jedi forces, Desolous was [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|destroyed]] alongside his army.<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=PS2, PSP and Wii}}</ref>

===Separatist Crisis===
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] vessel ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' was launched from Yaga Minor in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]]. It had 50,000 colonists destined for beyond the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|known]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It [[Battle for Outbound Flight|failed]] as a result of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] machinations.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|Grand Moff Tarkin ran a lot of his more private stuff through Yaga Minor, and he didn't want his political enemies getting even a glimpse of what he was up to.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] to [[Booster Terrik]]|<ref name="VotF" />}}
After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Yaga (species)|Yagai]] were quickly subjugated and enslaved. The Empire improved the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] above Yaga Minor and shipped Yagai technicians across the galaxy to help maintain the vast [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

The [[Yaga Minor weapons range|weapons range]] at Yaga Minor was rumored to have been an early testing ground for a prototype of the [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Sphere]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Yaga Minor was an important trade world, comparable to [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] and [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Ellorrs Madak}}</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="TEA" /> Yaga Minor was also the site of an important [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] base used by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to hide his more private information.<ref name="VotF" />

===Imperial Remnant===
{{Quote|Look at all that new construction. They aren't kidding around, are they?''"<br />"''No, they're not. Nor are they kidding around at Ord Trasi or Yaga Minor.|[[Dankin]] and [[Talon Karrde]], about the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
Yaga Minor was one of the last strongholds of the Empire in the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It featured a major cluster of [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|shipyards]] that proved instrumental in [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TTS" />

At the time of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], slavery was banned and the relationships between Yagai and the Empire were significantly improved, a result of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon's]] tolerant politics.<ref name="SotP" />

After [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Yaga Minor was the last [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control.<ref name="SotP" /> It was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kurlen Flennic]]<ref name="FH1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> and defended by forces of [[High General]] [[Hestiv]].<ref name="SotP" /> In the last days of the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], Yaga Minor was the site of the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|last battle]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Admiral Pellaeon later agreed to allow the New Republic's expert slicer [[Zakarisz Ghent]] search the databank files of the Ubiqtorate base for an original copy of the [[Caamas Document]].<ref name="VotF" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Imperial forces fleeing from [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] regrouped here before facing the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]]. A third of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet defeated there jumped to attack the shipyards, though they were [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|repelled]] in short order.<ref name="FH1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yaga Minor is clearly described in the novels ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' and ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' as being part of the Imperial Remnant, not far from the capital [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], the Imperial Remnant being a small group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However, the PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Yaga Minor in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Sesswenna sector]] (a misspelling of the true [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]) of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], in close proximity to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Seswenna sector is actually located in the Outer Rim.
